branch.description: minimal supersoliton matching branch with gauge-off and metric-spectator assumptions
assumptions: g_mu_nu = eta_mu_nu on the executed branch

reduced_action.formula: S_red = Omega_(d-1) int dt dr [ r^(d-1) ( 1/2 K(rho,phi) (rho')^2 + 1/2 (phi')^2 - V_eff(rho,phi) ) - r^(d-3) T_top(rho,phi; n, B) ]

effective_objects.K: projection of G_AB onto the background tangent
effective_objects.V_eff: V + U_mix evaluated on the executed background branch
effective_objects.T_top: angular/topological stress term induced by n^A(Omega) and winding/topological data

euler_lagrange.rho: d/dr [ r^(d-1) K(rho,phi) rho' ] - r^(d-1) [ 1/2 (partial_rho K) (rho')^2 - partial_rho V_eff ] + r^(d-3) partial_rho T_top = 0
euler_lagrange.phi: d/dr [ r^(d-1) phi' ] - r^(d-1) [ 1/2 (partial_phi K) (rho')^2 - partial_phi V_eff ] + r^(d-3) partial_phi T_top = 0

core: core data compatible with chosen topological branch

classification.reason: without them there is no supersoliton background to match

classification.object: positive regular K(rho,phi) along the background branch
classification.reason: required as the A3 input kernel metric

classification.object: critical point of V_eff at infinity
separate split of V and U_mix
classification.reason: A2 only constrains their sum along the background branch

classification.object: full off-branch tensor structure of G_AB
classification.reason: A2 needs only the projection onto the background tangent
orientation basis is not fixed by matching alone
both realize the minimal branch before physical flux is turned on

forced: regularity on the core and on the vacuum boundary
must admit an asymptotic critical point compatible with finite energy
optional: no unique decomposition into V and U_mix from A2 alone

forced: no leading-order constraint on the executed gauge-off branch
optional: specific gauge kinetic completion remains open

optional: specific functional form remains open in A2

decide whether gauge-on branch is needed for stabilization
